notes.title: Update on the Game’s Development
notes.content:
[p]These past few weeks have been pretty rough. I spent several days trying to fix some bugs and, at the same time, decided to improve [b]ALL[/b] of the cutscene artwork — both with and without dialogue.[/p][p]At the beginning of the month, I was really happy to have finally reached the final act of the game. But now that I’m reworking so much of the artwork, I had to go back to the very beginning, taking several steps back before I can move forward again.[/p][p]Taking advantage of this decision, I’m also adding new scenes and making some important changes. Even though I’m happy with the improvements I’ve made so far, there’s still a lot to finish, which means I’ll be “stuck” in Acts 1 and 2 for a while longer.[/p][p]My plan has always been to release the game this year (2025), but with these changes — plus the return of classes, my thesis, and my internship — honestly, I’m starting to have doubts about the release date. Still, I’ll keep giving my best to make sure the game launches in 2025 and deliver the best game possible![/p][p]Next month (August), I should update the demo with these new changes.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you,
[b]Justo Dias[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444805/9635dcd06e2ac1522e0b0195bdb8df179a9e1729.gif"][/img][/p]
